summary: Practice decks are editable .txt files in Documents\L5R Emperor\Decks (old user://decks decks copied across once, fallback to the old folder). Every shipped deck is also embedded read-only in preloaded-decks.json; the .txt copies are seeded once each, never overwritten, and a Restore shipped decks button puts a missing or edited original back. The pinned Lion and Crane stay embedded only (seed=false, unchanged, for the tutorial/pinned profile); the folder gets Classic Lion and Classic Crane instead (Focus removed; 3 Back to the Front in Lion, 3 Unorthodox Attack in Crane; Fate decks are 41 cards). Mantis Manipulation gains Shinden Shorai, Plains of Otosan Uchi, Suitengu's Blessing and Yoritomo's Guidance - exp (1 each) in the embedded copy and in the local .txt. The tutorial still plays its own embedded TutorialCards and never reads the deck folder.
validation: check.sh --skip-client passed on the final tree (deck-workshop test expects 15 embedded decks, pinned entries equal the pinned presets, Classic decks have no Focus and the 3 added cards, every embedded deck reads cleanly against the catalogue); check-practice-setup.sh and check-deck-builder.sh passed natively before the Classic/Mantis edits, check-practice-setup.sh after the Classic edit. Native checks use fixture folders: the real Documents folder, the migration and the Restore dialog were not exercised natively. No visual playthrough.
remaining: Not run against the real Documents folder or the Restore dialog. The tutorial does not yet load decks from the embedded files. Existing players keep their old .txt copies of changed shipped decks until they use Restore.
